papers.title: RegBridge: Inspectable AI-Assisted Decisions for Regulatory Document Reuse
papers.description: A prototype for reviewing FDA eCTD document reuse. An LLM produces citation-bounded findings, and deterministic rules make the final decision. On 12 held-out cases it was correct 11 times in each of 3 runs with no unsafe reuse, versus 83% accuracy for a rules-only baseline (2 unsafe reuses). React/FastAPI demo with 55 network-free integration tests.

papers.title: SimPhysQA: Evidence-Bound Language Annotation of Physical Simulations for Grounded Scientific Question Answering
papers.description: A dataset that adds timestamp-level language descriptions to MuJoCo/PyBullet trajectories across four domains, with every sentence bound to simulator fields and validated. Nine local LLM configurations reach up to 92.5% on direct readout but no more than 12.5% on prediction and 35% on counterfactuals. Under review.
